Resolved in ~9 s by a regex script keeping both sides, one Edit, and `cherry-pick --continue` (f471ce4); Board and Dump applied cleanly.

All three worktrees were created at 96d9c63 (origin/main, #92) instead of the stated base 83ae5a4 (the main checkout's branch). Each agent detected this on its own and moved its work back: Dump with `git reset --hard 83ae5a4` before starting (05:16:30), Board with `git rebase --onto 83ae5a4` after committing (05:19:01), Priorities with `git rebase --onto 83ae5a4 96d9c63` after committing (05:22:29). All three rebases applied cleanly.

The worktree guard refused 4 subagent Bash commands: Dump `cd` to the shared checkout (05:16:25) and a heredoc append 'too complex to verify' (05:19:01); Priorities sed with a runtime variable `$f` (05:18:54); Board `cd` to the shared checkout to run knip (05:19:51). Each agent reissued the step in another form. No main-session refusals.

Load imbalance: the Priorities agent (M-size page) ran 458.7 s with 73 tool uses and 211,671 subagent tokens, against ~289 s (Board, 44 tool uses) and ~292 s (Dump, 55 tool uses) from spawn to hand-back. The main session waited ~2.8 min after the Dump hand-back (05:20:58) for Priorities (05:23:45). It also left the Board and Dump cherry-picks until then, so integration was serialized behind the slowest agent.

Repeated work: each of the three agents separately investigated the same two environment quirks, the wrong worktree base and a knip failure (9 unused files under scripts/ plus test/seedWeek.ts, caused by the base's `.claude/worktrees/` .gitignore line and seen only inside a worktree). Board and Priorities each re-ran knip on a detached 83ae5a4 to prove it was not their change.

Missing interface contract across the briefs: placement and naming of the page-props types were not fixed. Dump put its type in src/types/dump.ts, while Priorities exported `PrioritiesPageProps` from utils/oneOffUtils.ts. After merging, the main session moved it to src/types/priorities.ts as `PrioritiesPageData` and amended the Priorities commit (a027245). The briefs also left the shared Design Console files (constants.ts, DomainTab.tsx) unpartitioned, which led to the conflict above.

Main-session tool error, trivial: `ls .github/*TEMPLATE* …` exited 2 because no PR template exists (05:31:02). The Priorities agent's `git merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 1 (05:22:08) was a check that returned false, not a failure.

Everything else went to plan. setup --no-db took 24 s and the three worktree agents were spawned 25 s after it. All four agents completed. Results: format/lint/typecheck/knip clean, npm test 434 passed (+2 expected fail), e2e 26/26, check:clicks 16/16 with 0 console errors, ui-verifier PASS. PR #7 was opened and all 7 CI checks went green on the first push, with no CI fixes and no stop-hook turns.

Board、Priorities 和 Dump 三页都已按 spike 的 Part 1 改成 Projects 页的页面结构。PR 已开：https://github.com/Marsuu1994/mars-workbench-lab-try2/pull/7 ，目标分支是 `experiment/base-try2`，head 上 7 个 CI check 全部通过。分支是 `claude/page-structure-try2-b4`，每页一个 commit，另加一个文档 commit。

## 每页改了什么
- **Board**（`cdc847f`）
  - `KanbanBoard` 改名为 `BoardPage`，接手了原 `BoardScreen` 的 header、dashboard 和两层布局 wrapper；`BoardScreen` 已删除。
  - 新增 `BoardPageContext`，只放 `pullToTodo`；`MobileBacklogCard` 不再收 `onPull`，改从 context 取。
- **Dump**（`a4b1bc8`）
  - `DumpScreen` 改名为 `DumpPage`；新增 `DumpPageContext`（capture、captureError、loadMore）。
  - `DumpComposer` 不再收 props，`DumpFeed` 从 4 个 prop 减到 3 个。
  - route 里原来 inline 的整形抽成 adapter `toDumpPageProps`，带 unit test。
- **Priorities**（`a027245`）
  - `PriorityMatrixPage` 改名为 `PrioritiesPage`，接手了 `PrioritiesScreen`（已删除）。
  - 新增 `PrioritiesPageContext`；`QuadrantCell` 和 `MatrixTaskCard` 的 prop 都从 9 个减到 2 个。
  - 新增 route adapter `toPrioritiesPageProps`，以及纯函数 `groupTasksByQuadrant`、`isTrackedTask`，都有 unit test。
- **Design Console**：scenario 直接渲染各页的 container，fixture 经同一个 adapter 转换；gallery 里需要 context 的组件包在只有空操作 handler 的 inert context 里。
- **文档**（`ba75fce`）：更新了 `baseline.md`、AGENTS.md、Design Console README、tracker（删掉已完成的 sub-bullet）和 README 的 Update Log。

## 跑过的检查（都在合并后的分支上）
- `format:check`、`lint`、`typecheck`、`knip`：通过。
- `npm test`：434 条通过，另有 2 条是已有的 `it.fails`，按预期失败。
- `npm run test:e2e`：26 条全部通过。
- `npm run check:clicks`：**16/16 通过，0 个 console error**。
- Board 的 `ui-verifier`：5 个 tab 在桌面（1280×800）和手机（390×844）两种宽度下全部 PASS。

## Judgment calls（PR 描述里也写了）
- **怎么组织的**：三个 subagent 各在一个 worktree 里并行改一页，我按 Board、Dump、Priorities 的顺序 cherry-pick。
  - 冲突在 `src/app/design/constants.ts` 和 `src/app/design/tabs/DomainTab.tsx`，两边加的内容都保留了。
  - subagent 的 worktree 实际建在 `96d9c63`，不是 `83ae5a4`；它们各自把 commit 移回了 `83ae5a4`。
  - worktree 里 knip 报 `scripts/` 下文件未使用，原因是 base 的 `.claude/worktrees/` 那行 gitignore；合并后在主目录跑是干净的。
- **类型位置**：Priorities 的 props 类型我改放到 `src/types/priorities.ts`，命名为 `PrioritiesPageData`，
